message: Hm. Not having read Lakoff, I'll say that I can see how the metaphors might work, but when you ask what things are consonant with one another, I worry about piling too many metaphors atop one another. After all, reciprocity can be constructed both as generosity of spirit and also as adherence to exchange. There's a continuum from "consevative" to "liberal" (and of course, even something as two-dimensional as the Political Compass shows us how reductive that continuum is), but is it elitist to wonder whether there's also a continuum of political nuance?
